critical_code_review_comments: i18n key coverage: 51/51 wizard_* and 41/41 prog_* keys are symmetric between fr and en — excellent parity. GuidedWizard.js and PrivateProgramming.js contain NO hardcoded French JSX text (verified by grep of accented characters in JSX text nodes).

Chat cache hydration in Chat.js (lines 146-217) follows the requested pattern: synchronous hydrate from getCachedChatHistory before the async fetch (no spinner if cache exists), then silent background refresh that re-sets messages and re-caches. The dependency array on the persistence effect includes cacheChatHistory (which is useCallback-stable) — clean implementation. One micro-inefficiency: the persistence effect runs on EVERY messages change including the initial hydrate, causing one extra redundant localStorage write per chat open — harmless but could be guarded with a hasHydrated ref.

Login.js still ships a hardcoded French span (line 834) and toast (line 496) — these are leftovers that contradict the iter102 i18n cleanup goal. The translation keys for the span already exist in both languages but the JSX is not consuming them.

Cache localStorage key in CacheContext.js is 'codeforge_chat_history' (CACHE_KEYS.CHAT_HISTORY), NOT 'cf_chat_history_v1' as the review request mentions. Functionally correct, but documentation/instruction drift.
Two prog_* translation keys (prog_ai_subtitle, prog_site_subtitle) are defined but never referenced in PrivateProgramming.js — dead translation entries.
